summary: Iter 609 tested end-to-end. Backend 7/7 pytest passing (arrival reminder T-2 for TR booking → mocked email in email_outbox with 'google.com/maps' + 'Giriş saati'; idempotency verified; log entry lang=tr, subject startsWith '2 gün sonra görüşürüz'; DE preview subject startsWith 'Bis in 2 Tagen'; automation/settings lists arrival_reminder + ota_ab_auto_winner; event packages GET public / POST use_default (£25) / PUT enabled false / DELETE ok / DELETE 404; /book with package_id → booking.package.total==50, booking.total==rate*2+50, invalid package_id → 400; A/B auto winner with 25 A views + 25 B views + 5 B bookings + 1 A booking → locked.variant='B', pct=8, emails≥1; ota-conversion returns direct_advantage_pct=8, ab.enabled=false, ab.auto_locked.variant='B'; notification 'A/B kazananı' created). Frontend widget /book/default?lang=tr → be-event-package-* buttons present with text '🎁 Paketli rezerve et · +£25/gece', click seeds selection: be-selected-package chip = 'Etkinlik Paketi: kahvaltı + geç çıkış (14:00) · +£25/gece', 2× be-room-package-* lines appear, room total updates from £200 → £250 (+£50 for 2 nights) → matches spec; be-remove-package clears chip and lines. Admin Booking Engine Manager → 'Misafir Yolculuğu' tab (testid=bea-tab-journey) renders arrival-reminder-card + event-packages-card: arrival-run-now returns toast '0 aday · 0 gönderildi · 0 MOCK…' (correct after cleanup); arrival-preview-de opens arrival-preview-panel with iframe showing 'Bis in 2 Tagen' subject and 'Wir bereiten Ihr Zimmer vor' body; event-package-form add flow succeeds → row 'Test Paket / Test Package · +£10/gece', event-package-toggle-* button label 'Pasifleştir' visible, event-package-delete-* removes row. OTA Commission panel shows ota-ab-card with AKTİF badge + hint 'Kazanan için her varyantta ≥20 gösterim ve ≥2 puan fark gerekir'. All seed / test data cleaned up; exactly one enabled £25 default event package retained under property_id='default'; config restored (ota_ab_enabled=true, direct_advantage_pct=5, ota_ab_variant_b_pct=8, ota_ab_auto_locked unset).

ui_bugs.issue: Review request specifies data-testid 'journey-tab' but the actual DOM uses 'bea-tab-journey'. All child testids (arrival-*, event-package-*) are correct. Consider adding an alias or renaming to match the documented convention so external test suites relying on 'journey-tab' don't break.

Card header shows 'Etkinlik Paketleri (0)' immediately after adding a new package while the row actually renders in the DOM (event-package-row-<id> present with correct text). Counter appears not to refresh from the same list used for rendering (or filters by property_id !== activePropertyId='all'). Cosmetic mismatch only — CRUD works.

design_issues.screen: Booking Engine Manager → Misafir Yolculuğu (branch=All Branches)
issues: When branch is 'All Branches', event-packages-card shows 0 rows because default seeded package is scoped to property_id='default'. Users on 'all' scope see empty even though data exists per-property. Consider aggregating or auto-switching scope to a specific property when opening the tab (same class of issue flagged in iter 608 for OTA Commission).

action_items: (Optional) Add 'journey-tab' data-testid alias (or rename) on the Misafir Yolculuğu tab trigger to align with the spec. Current: bea-tab-journey.
(Optional) Fix event-packages-card header count to reflect rendered rows immediately after add/delete, or filter both by the same active property scope.
(Optional, iter608 recurrence) Aggregate per-property scopes when activePropertyId='all' so admin sees seeded packages / A/B config across the fleet.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/pms/arrival_reminder.py: idempotency via booking.arrival_reminder_sent_at + query filter — correct; sends both today+1 and today+2 candidates in one pass; DEFAULT_UPSELLS localised properly.

arrival_reminder.py: uses `b.get('guest_lang')`; booking_widget writes it as `guest_lang` from `data['lang']` — the widget flow uses `lang`, so upstream callers must send `lang` (not `guest_lang`). Documented in test.
booking_widget.py create_widget_booking: package_id validation is enabled-aware; correctly returns 400 on unknown id; package total added post-ABS/coupon — order verified.
run_ab_auto_winner_internal: locks winner, disables ota_ab_enabled, records lock; email_outbox+notifications persisted; guardrail (min 20 views, ≥2 pts diff) matches spec.
ota_conversion 'all'-scope fallback (any_ab) is applied — good; but event_packages doesn't have the same fallback for 'all', causing the empty admin view flagged above.
GuestJourneyCards: card header count derives from a possibly stale list state after mutation. Ensure setState uses functional updater or re-fetch on success.

Journey tab testid is `bea-tab-journey` (not `journey-tab`). Branch selector at [data-testid="branch-selector-btn"]; default admin is 'All Branches'.
